what: Kev-0.8B: the published decoder alone on the Mac GPU (the fp32 Metal chunk kernel at a static S = 128; AOT h16c .aimodelc, Python runtime), against the author's fp32 oracle through its pointer head: the fixture (434 questions) and the held-out set (130), the red arms v2, and every process's re-run of its first row (round 11). export_record = the export that wrote the .aimodel (round 11); bundle_record = the step that wrote the published bundle's metadata around those bytes (round 15); rows_check = the Swift host's ids on the published bundle.

removed: runs[].call_ms and timing.first_call_of_process_ms (per-call ms; the timing block keeps the medians)
runs[].npz / npz_key, processes[].npz / npz_sha256, oracle.npz_sha256 (lane file names and hashes of hidden dumps)
runs[].hidden.lowest_positions (each run keeps min_pos_cos, its index and the position counts)
runs[].probs_oracle (the oracle's probabilities are in the fixture file)
processes[].descriptor (identical to the top-level descriptor: descriptor_same_in_every_process)
other_gpu_processes (command lines of other sessions' processes)
red arm items' instr_old / instr_new (transfer-v4 question text; each item keeps its row id and numbers)
summary: round 11's record of this form only (the other forms are in gate-kev-0.8b-forms.json)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_kev/ (not in the repository)
trimmed.paths: local paths rewritten: the lane directory as $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_kev, the repository relative, the home directory as ~, temporary directories as $TMPDIR, Xcode as $DEVELOPER_DIR, the phone's app container as <app container>

rows_check.check: gate_swift.g1_record: ids / indices / keys / packed ids / state / input_tokens

readout.gate: decoder alone on the Mac GPU (oracle row ids), the fp16 hidden read through the fp32 pointer head
readout.readout: one row per question, fresh zero states per row; a row of T ids runs as ceil(T / 128) calls of 'main' (static S = 128): call k gets ids[128k : 128k + 128] with position_ids 0..128k+127; the last call is padded with <|endoftext|> (248044) and the hidden rows of the padded positions are discarded (causal: they cannot reach a real position). The hidden rows [1, 128, 1024] of every call, concatenated and cut to T, are the backbone's final-norm last_hidden_state [T, 1024] the head reads. A row fits when ceil(T / 128) * 128 <= 4095 (the position dim's upper bound; the KV sequence dim is allocated at 4096).

bar.argmax: every question with an oracle top-2 margin above 0.02; near-ties listed apart
bar.max_abs_dp_applies_to: every option of every question, near-ties included
bar.reset: bit-equal hidden rows in every process
bar.mean_of_run_mean_abs_dp_definition: mean over runs (one run = one row = one question) of the mean |dp| over that question's options

environment.head: the pointer head from head.safetensors, fp32, CPU (parity_decoder_torch.KevHead)
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, no _GPU_LOCK held (times are contended reference values)

red_arms_v2.rule: red = the perturbed runs against the unperturbed ones fail the gate's own bar (FACTS §7): (a) an argmax moves on at least one question whose oracle top-2 margin is above 0.02, or (b) max |dp| > 0.02, or (c) the mean over runs of the run's mean |dp| > 0.002
red_arms_v2.v1_rule: argmax moved on >= 1 row AND max |dp| > 0.02
red_arms_v2.note: round 11 red arms v2, form K128
